name: State button
detail: A button that carries the action through progress and completion. Use the demo replay to study the state changes.
when: Save and submit actions that already have pending/success/error state.
integration: Use the host save callback through onAction. Preserve validation, disabled state, and retry rules. Never use the simulation as real persistence.

name: Sliding tabs
description: A selection that carries its momentum.
detail: A shared selection surface follows the active tab. Designed for a small set of modes or views.
when: A small set of modes, filters, or views with an existing selected value.
integration: Connect value/onValueChange and supply items. Keep each tab associated with its existing panel.
props: items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, ariaLabel, speed, radius, className, style

name: Morphing menu
description: A small surface becomes the next step.
detail: A trigger and its options share one visual surface. Keep the menu close to the action it supports.
when: A compact action trigger opening a nearby set of commands.
integration: Supply actions with onSelect callbacks and a label. Preserve menu focus and keyboard behavior. In an existing Radix menu, adapt the surface motion instead of replacing the primitive.
props: actions, label, speed, radius, className, style

name: Text swap
description: A new thought, without a hard cut.
detail: Soft directional transitions for short statuses and labels. Keep essential information readable and announce changes appropriately.
when: Short status messages that change as an operation progresses.
integration: Connect the status index with value; supply statuses with text and icons. Keep a single polite announcement for a meaningful change.
props: statuses, value, speed, radius, className, style

name: Expanding search
description: Space appears exactly when you need it.
detail: A compact search trigger opens into an editable field, with deliberate focus handling and an easy return.
when: Compact search or filter controls that need more space on focus.
integration: Connect value/onValueChange; onSearch submits the query. Supply actual searchable items or replace demonstration result rendering.
props: items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onSearch, placeholder, speed, radius, className, style

name: Toast stack
description: Feedback with a little sense of space.
detail: Transient feedback stacks and settles as notifications arrive or leave. Preview messages are demonstration data.
when: A notification system with multiple recent messages.
integration: Adapt the stack geometry to the existing toast provider. This reference uses a local Preview toast control; preserve the host provider's lifecycle, expiry, pause, live region, and dismissal semantics.
props: title, description, replayKey, speed, radius, className, style

name: Copy feedback
description: A tiny confirmation that feels complete.
detail: A clipboard action with precise state feedback. Copy succeeds only after the browser accepts the write.
when: Copying a command, URL, identifier, or other text.
integration: Pass the exact text. Confirm only after the clipboard write succeeds and preserve the manual fallback.

name: Rolling counter
detail: Digits move in the direction of the value change. Useful for quantities, totals, and compact numerical adjustments.
when: Adjustable integer quantities, totals, or compact counters.
integration: Connect value/onValueChange and the allowed range. The reference supports 0–999; adapt digit count explicitly for larger ranges or signed values.
props: value, defaultValue, onValueChange, min, max, label, speed, radius, className, style

name: Accordion
description: More detail. The same quiet rhythm.
detail: Disclosure with a continuous height change and a coordinated content reveal. Preserve the relationship between heading and content.
when: Expandable help, preferences, and short supporting details.
integration: Supply items and connect value/onValueChange if controlled. Keep the heading/panel relationship and make closed interactive content inert.
props: items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, speed, radius, className, style

name: Icon morph
description: The same strokes. A different intention.
detail: Three SVG strokes draw together and become a close icon. One continuous motion preserves the shape through rapid reversals.
when: A menu or panel toggle that needs a clear change of state.
integration: Connect pressed/onPressedChange to the actual panel state. Keep the stable label and existing focus management. Forward aria-controls to the panel and preserve host dismissal behavior. Replay changes only the icon, never the application state.
props: pressed, defaultPressed, onPressedChange, label, labels, disabled, buttonRef, native button attributes, speed, radius, className, style
